body:
# My-Net Asia

**My-Net Asia** is a small hobby Minecraft server project where new ideas and plugins are developed and tested.

The server currently includes multiple gameplay modes such as **Survival (SMP)** and **Skyblock**, along with core features like **land claiming**, **economy**, and **player trading (`/trade`)**.

Several **custom plugins** are actively being developed and tested on the server. Because of this, players may occasionally encounter **new experimental features** as part of ongoing development.

---

## Features

- Survival (SMP)
- Skyblock
- Land claiming system
- Economy system
- Player trading (`/trade`)
- Custom plugins under active development

---

## Why Join

- Small community server  
- Regular improvements and feature experiments  
- Focus on **stable gameplay** and **server performance**

---

## Project Purpose

This server is maintained as a **personal hobby and learning project**.  
It serves as a platform to experiment with **Minecraft plugin development**, test new ideas, and improve server systems.

---

## Notes

Some features may change over time as new systems are tested and refined.
